scope: Read-only-to-host, disposable native guest KMS probes. Direct DRM producer replaces compositor for deterministic protocol tests. This is not full Blent/tablet acceptance or Mutter51 validation.

versions.library: Installed AppDir libevdi1.15.0, identical in both tests

isolation: Initramfs guest only, no host disk/network/input passthrough; virtio-vga-gl uses host render node. Probes require blent-evdi-review=1 in guest kernel command line. No host EVDI attachment, driver load/reload, installation or source patch.
method: Archive upstream tag into separate scratch directory; make -C /lib/modules/7.0.0-34-generic/build M=<archive>/module modules.
Reuse T700 guest root preparation; install real libdrm/libevdi and probe dynamic dependencies; include 640x480 EDID generated with scripts/gen-edid.py make_edid.
Compile probes with cc -O2 -I/usr/include/libdrm -Ihost/evdi, -ldrm and exact AppDir/libevdi.so.1 for kms-probe.
Boot once with distro evdi.ko.zst and once with compressed unmodified1.15.1 module at same guest path; both roots precreate two devices before Xorg.

Run native-init.sh as PID1. KMS probe scans card index by DRM driver identity, selects640x480 XR24, captures known background, tests idle watchdog sequence, cursor show/hide, and immediate disconnect/connect with no producer modeset.

QEMU arguments: -machine q35,accel=kvm -cpu host -m2048 -smp2 -nodefaults; OVMF_CODE_4M.fd and scratch writable VARS; kernel7.0.0-34-generic; generated initrd; console=ttyS0 rdinit=/init loglevel=4 blent-evdi-review=1; -device virtio-vga-gl -display egl-headless,rendernode=/dev/dri/renderD128 -serial file:<log> -no-reboot; outer timeout45s.

observations.T748: Idle request returns false. After300ms without producer damage, GRABPIX returns0 rects; retry false. Kernel emits grab-before-ready and duplicate-request warnings. Subsequent cursor damage delivers readiness and one rect with changed pixel on both versions. This reproduces the warning mechanism without frame corruption in this bounded sample; not attribution of all historical warnings.
observations.T749: Distro1.14.15 reconnect: no second mode event, false request, GRABPIX error Scanout buffer not set,0 rects, old cursor pixel remains. Stock1.15.1 reconnect: second mode event, true request, one rect and restored background ff000080. Same library/probe; no producer modeset between disconnect/connect. Import-size invalid boundaries were not exercised. Host module disassembly allocates page-pointer array using SG-page count without a maximum with dma-buf length, consistent with pre-#563 implementation.
observations.T752: Both drivers advertise XR24/AR24/XB24/AB24 on primary and cursor planes but ADDFB2 also succeeds for XR30/AR30. This reproduces framebuffer admission mismatch; no atomic AR30 commit or Mutter51 runtime was tested.
observations.T753: Both drivers: background ff000080; cursor set succeeds; capture one rect and pixel00ffffff. Cursor plane removal succeeds; request false, no readiness, GRABPIX0 rects; pixel remains00ffffff. On1.15.1 reconnect full refresh restores ff000080, confirming underlying background intact.
observations.T750: No concurrent compositor pacing/race or actual presentation timing measured; direct KMS fixture cannot establish absence of those faults.

limitations: First kms-distro.log used legacy cursor setter which returnedEINVAL; cursor conclusions use kms-distro-cursor.log and kms-stock.log only.
Temporary probes are retained evidence, not permanent normal-suite regressions and not a behavioral fix.
No claimed host/tablet end-to-end result or performance improvement.
Maintainer reaffirmed stock EVDI only; no locally maintained kernel/libevdi patches.
